
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/grey-wolf/p/19933034" title="发布于 2026-04-26 16:14">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">spring cloud项目中，在bootstrap.yml中指定了active的profile，结果不生效</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="问题描述">问题描述</h1>
<p>接手的一个spring cloud项目，我最近在对其进行改造，更符合自己的习惯。我个人习惯在bootsrap.yml中指定spring.profiles.active，如下所示，只要修改spring.profiles.active的值，就能切换到想要的profile去，使用对应的nacos配置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">spring:
  application:
    name: demo-svc
  profiles:
    active: dev


---
spring:
  config:
    activate:
      on-profile: dev
  cloud:
    nacos:
      config:
        username: xxx
        password: xxxx
        enabled: false
        file-extension: yaml #文件扩展名
        server-addr: 1.1.1.1:8848
        namespace: 148586df-f999-4f83-a2fe-39b9add32196
---
spring:
  config:
    activate:
      on-profile: test
  cloud:
    nacos:
      config:
        username: xxx
        password: xxxx
        enabled: true
        file-extension: yaml #文件扩展名
        server-addr: 1.1.1.1:8848
        namespace: dfcf830b-0cd3-433b-bf35-6d153b9f142d
</code></pre>
<p>当然，上面文件中的profile为dev，我们还可以在命令行启动脚本中指定("java -Dspring.profiles.active=prod -jar demo.jar")，命令行中优先级最高，此时profile就是prod。</p>
<p>当然，命令行中不指定时，就应该是bootsrap.yml中的为准。</p>
<p>我这次问题就是发生在，命令行未指定的情况下，bootstrap.yml中指定了dev这个profile。</p>
<p>下图，我这里并未启用nacos，此时按理说就会去找application-dev.yml这个配置：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426144836780.png" alt="image-20260426144836780" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426144951174.png" alt="image-20260426144951174" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>最终，却好像是没去读取application-dev.yml，导致程序读取不到配置，直接启动失败了。</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426145107701.png" alt="image-20260426145107701" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>但是，我发现，服务器上运行时，我们都是在命令行中指定了profile，运行是完全正常的：</p>
<pre><code>"java -Dspring.profiles.active=dev -jar demo.jar"
</code></pre>
<p>为啥不在命令行中指定就不行呢（在本地idea中启动，我都是不会加命令行参数的，按理说就会取bootstrap.yml中的profile）？</p>
<p>框架版本，spring-boot基本是2.7.*中的最高版本了，cloud版本是2021.0.5。</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">&lt;properties&gt;
    &lt;java.version&gt;1.8&lt;/java.version&gt;
    &lt;spring-boot.version&gt;2.7.16&lt;/spring-boot.version&gt;
    &lt;spring-cloud-alibaba.version&gt;2021.0.5.0&lt;/spring-cloud-alibaba.version&gt;
    &lt;spring-cloud.version&gt;2021.0.5&lt;/spring-cloud.version&gt;
&lt;/properties&gt;
</code></pre>
<h1 id="简略排查过程">简略排查过程</h1>
<h2 id="正常和异常情况下的对比">正常和异常情况下的对比</h2>
<p>由于可以复现，且在本地可以debug，而且可以对比，正常和异常时的情况，这个问题肯定是能找到的。</p>
<p>我发现，正常情况下（本地idea启动时指定下命令行参数），在查找配置值时，一般就是去Environment中的propertySource列表中查找，正常长这样：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426150142389.png" alt="image-20260426150142389" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>上图所示，是有一个classpath下的resource：application-dev.yml。这个propertySource的类型是<code>com.ulisesbocchio.jasyptspringboot.wrapper.EncryptableMapPropertySourceWrapper</code>，大家可能有点奇怪，不熟悉这个类，这个是因为我们项目在生产环境里，对配置文件中的值进行了加密（比如数据库密码）。</p>
<p>这个加解密用的是：</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">&lt;dependency&gt;
    &lt;groupId&gt;com.github.ulisesbocchio&lt;/groupId&gt;
    &lt;artifactId&gt;jasypt-spring-boot-starter&lt;/artifactId&gt;
    &lt;version&gt;3.0.4&lt;/version&gt;
&lt;/dependency&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>本来正常情况下，propertySource的类型大概是这样：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426150616235.png" alt="image-20260426150616235" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>然后，jasypt这个加解密组件，就把上述的propertySource类型全给转成了它自己的：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">EncryptableMapPropertySourceWrapper
</code></pre>
<p>然后内部再包含了原始的propertySource：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426150847513.png" alt="image-20260426150847513" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>debug发现，EncryptableMapPropertySourceWrapper中包含的原始的propertySource类型为：</p>
<pre><code>org.springframework.boot.env.OriginTrackedMapPropertySource
</code></pre>
<h2 id="origintrackedmappropertysource初始化">OriginTrackedMapPropertySource初始化</h2>
<p>我们接下来看看，正常情况下，OriginTrackedMapPropertySource是啥时候初始化的。</p>
<p>打个断点：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426151137022.png" alt="image-20260426151137022" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>最后发现new的时机大概是，applicationContext这个上下文完成了environmentPrepared后，就会发布一个org.springframework.boot.context.event.ApplicationEnvironmentPreparedEvent，这时候各个listener就会处理这个事件。</p>
<p>其中一个listener为：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">org.springframework.boot.env.EnvironmentPostProcessorApplicationListener
</code></pre>
<p>这个listener中会找到各个EnvironmentPostProcessor，这个后置处理器接口，类似于bean的那些后置处理器，也是spring给我们提供的扩展点，这个org.springframework.boot.env.EnvironmentPostProcessor主要就是方便我们对Environment进行后置处理。</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426151852113.png" alt="image-20260426151852113" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426152118355.png" alt="image-20260426152118355" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>在我这边，找到的Environment后置处理器还是很多：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426152210139.png" alt="image-20260426152210139" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>其中的第7个ConfigDataEnvironmentPostProcessor就是本文主角：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426152322606.png" alt="image-20260426152322606" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>它就会到处去找配置：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426152441906.png" alt="image-20260426152441906" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426153002831.png" alt="image-20260426153002831" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>如果想要完整了解这块的流程，可以打开logger配置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">&lt;logger name="org.springframework.boot.context.config" level="TRACE"/&gt;
&lt;logger name="org.springframework.boot.logging" level="TRACE"/&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>大概流程如下：</p>
<p>查找的位置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">04-26 15:30:47.949 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataEnvironment Adding initial config data import from location 'optional:file:./;optional:file:./config/;optional:file:./config/*/' [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:30:47.949 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataEnvironment Adding initial config data import from location 'optional:classpath:/;optional:classpath:/config/' [DeferredLog.java:249]
</code></pre>
<p>查找的文件：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">04-26 15:30:47.949 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./application.yaml [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:30:47.949 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./application.yml [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:30:47.949 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./application.properties [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:30:47.949 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./application.json [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:30:47.949 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./application.xml [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:30:47.949 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./config/application.yaml [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:30:47.949 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./config/application.yml [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:30:47.954 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./config/application.properties [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:30:47.954 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./config/application.json [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:30:47.954 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./config/application.xml [DeferredLog.java:249]
</code></pre>
<p>在计算了profile后，如：profile为dev，则：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426153545865.png" alt="image-20260426153545865" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="问题原因">问题原因</h2>
<p>后来经过反复对比正常和异常情况下的代码路径，发现异常情况下，计算出来的active的profile竟然是空的。正常情况下，profile是dev。</p>
<p>然后重点查下面的代码：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426153707857.png" alt="image-20260426153707857" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426153736920.png" alt="image-20260426153736920" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426153755488.png" alt="image-20260426153755488" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426154013208.png" alt="image-20260426154013208" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426154100874.png" alt="image-20260426154100874" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="environment获取profile为啥是null">Environment获取profile为啥是null</h2>
<p>我们知道，在environment中包含了propertySource的list，我在对比异常情况下的list发现，如下的propertySource有差别，正常情况下，我这边，profile是在bootstrap.yml这种指定的，那就应该正常如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426154640153.png" alt="image-20260426154640153" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>上图中，names这个数组里，包含了两个bootstrap.yml，其实就是如下这两段配置：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426154741557.png" alt="image-20260426154741557" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>但是在异常情况下，names数组是空的：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426154807965.png" alt="image-20260426154807965" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>切到这个propertySource的代码一看，找了下操作names数组的地方：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426155001831.png" alt="image-20260426155001831" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>发现会判断propertySource是不是OriginTrackedMapPropertySource类型，而我们知道的是，那个加密组件，会把正常的OriginTrackedMapPropertySource类型的propertySource转成EncryptableMapPropertySourceWrapper，而这个EncryptableMapPropertySourceWrapper就不是OriginTrackedMapPropertySource的子类，所以这里就没法加入到names数组。</p>
<h2 id="修改方式">修改方式</h2>
<p>我以前就被这个加密组件坑过一次了，改的方式就是：</p>
<p>直接把这个类的源码拷贝了一份，改了一下，放到项目的src下（包名不能变）：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426155256620.png" alt="image-20260426155256620" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426155322758.png" alt="image-20260426155322758" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="add方法的调用时机">add方法的调用时机</h2>
<p>上述这个方法什么时候调用的呢，其实就是在上文说的，applicationContext这个上下文完成了environmentPrepared后，就会发布一个org.springframework.boot.context.event.ApplicationEnvironmentPreparedEvent，这时候各个listener就会处理这个事件。</p>
<p>前面那个listener是下图第3个，这里我们add方法这块，就是在第一个listener中调用的：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">org.springframework.cloud.bootstrap.BootstrapApplicationListener
</code></pre>
<p>这个listener就负责了spring cloud中boostrap阶段的工作（支持bootstrap.yml，从nacos这类配置中心读取配置）。</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426160115782.png" alt="image-20260426160115782" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>在这个listener中：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426160558704.png" alt="image-20260426160558704" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>下图所示，这个listener中也会生成一个bootstrap阶段的applicationContext，且也会查找自己的各个propertySource作为自己的env（包括去查找各个bootstrap.yml等配置文件）</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426160728936.png" alt="image-20260426160728936" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">04-26 15:55:39.725 [main] TRACE [] o.s.b.c.config.ConfigDataEnvironmentContributors Processing imports [optional:file:./;optional:file:./config/;optional:file:./config/*/] [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.725 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./bootstrap.yaml [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.725 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./bootstrap.yml [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./bootstrap.properties [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./bootstrap.json [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./bootstrap.xml [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./config/bootstrap.yaml [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./config/bootstrap.yml [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./config/bootstrap.properties [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./config/bootstrap.json [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource file:./config/bootstrap.xml [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataImporter Considering resource file [.] from location optional:file:./;optional:file:./config/;optional:file:./config/*/ [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLoaders Loading file [.] using loader org.springframework.boot.context.config.StandardConfigDataLoader [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataImporter Loaded resource file [.] from location optional:file:./;optional:file:./config/;optional:file:./config/*/ [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.b.c.config.ConfigDataEnvironmentContributors Imported 1 resource [file [.]] [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.b.c.config.ConfigDataEnvironmentContributors Processing imports [optional:classpath:/;optional:classpath:/config/] [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource classpath:/bootstrap.yaml [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource classpath:/bootstrap.properties [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource classpath:/bootstrap.json [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource classpath:/bootstrap.xml [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource classpath:/config/bootstrap.yaml [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource classpath:/config/bootstrap.yml [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource classpath:/config/bootstrap.properties [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource classpath:/config/bootstrap.json [DeferredLog.java:249]
04-26 15:55:39.726 [main] TRACE [] o.s.boot.context.config.ConfigDataLocationResolver Skipping missing resource classpath:/config/bootstrap.xml [DeferredLog.java:249]

<p>最终，bootstrap阶段这些配置，是需要合并到原来的env里的。</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426161053892.png" alt="image-20260426161053892" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>下图就是触发add方法的地方（就是需要修改代码的那里）：</p>
<p><img src="https://dump-1252523945.cos.ap-shanghai.myqcloud.com/img/image-20260426161145364.png" alt="image-20260426161145364" loading="lazy"></p>
